title: University of Kansas kicks off week of 2026 Homecoming activities
summary_en: The University of Kansas will host its 114th Homecoming, sponsored by Central Bank, Oct. 19-25. The week culminates with the KU football game against Baylor on Oct. 24 at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium.

title: 2026 midterm elections: University of Kansas experts available to comment
summary_en: From artificial intelligence to tariffs to the administration of elections, KU scholars from a variety of disciplines are available to speak with news media.
